Message:
build(Output): Remove compiled Configuration artifacts and normalize Source formatting

Delete all generated ESBuild output files (.js and .js.map) from the Configuration/ directory that were previously checked into version control. The Configuration/ directory is the ESBuild outdir for bundled artifacts consumed by Cocoon at runtime — these are build outputs, not source.

Retain and reformat the authoritative Source/ modules: Source/ESBuild/Output.js (entry point with RestPlugin conditional loading, PostHog build telemetry, target cleanup logic) and tsconfig.json (composite project config extending @playform/build). Both files normalized to compact spacing without inter-statement blank lines.

This ensures the repository tracks only source-of-truth configuration while Cocoon continues to consume fresh builds from Configuration/ at runtime via the existing build pipeline.
